notes.title: Update Optimizations:
notes.notes: [p]Update Optimizations: [/p][p]1. Optimized the response speed of the navigation system for faster reactions (specifically addressing multi-pet response issues). [/p][p]2. Improved companion creature following and teleportation distances to prevent player obstruction. [/p][p]3. Fixed an issue where pets wouldn't reset after losing their target when loading a saved game.[/p]

notes.title: Update Optimization:
notes.notes: [p]Update Optimization: [/p][p]1. Optimized the underlying code of the AI navigation system and fixed two issues. (These issues may have caused: AI navigation disorder, AI navigation failure (standing idle), AI getting stuck against walls)[/p]

notes.title: Update Optimizations:
notes.notes: [p]Update Optimizations: [/p][p]1. Added nutrient solution recipes to the distilled water device and dew collector. [/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where beast wave monsters would often run into water when losing their target. [/p][p]3. Fixed an issue where beast waves would not attack the player's base when too far away.[/p][p] 4. Optimized the behavior of No.17 getting stuck in walls until passing through.[/p]

notes.title: Update Optimizations:
notes.notes: [p]Update Optimizations: [/p][p]1. Added safety reset for NPCs when loading saves outside safe zones (underground). [/p][p]2. Removed NPC affection limit, allowing all NPCs to reach 100 affection.[/p][p] 3. Increased NPC skill leveling speed. [/p][p]4. Fixed issue where NPC constitution couldn't progress beyond level 8. [/p][p]5. Improved NPC turning speed to prevent endless circling when unable to reach destinations. [/p][p]6. Increased beast wave intensity cap from 20 to 100 (recent optimizations for group combat allow higher settings - adjust according to your device performance). [/p][p]7. Raised gathering multiplier cap from 3 to 5 (this helps builders and casual players - 5 is the optimal multiplier after balancing considerations).[/p]

notes.title: Update & Optimizations:
notes.notes: [p]Update & Optimizations: [/p][p]1. Improved the issue of raindrops penetrating buildings. (Balanced between performance and precision to minimize raindrops penetrating structures) [/p][p]2. Increased ceiling size to avoid gaps. [/p][p]3. Fixed an issue where after dying, returning to the main menu and loading a save then dying again would not show the death screen.[/p]

notes.title: Update & Optimizations:
notes.notes: [p]Update & Optimizations: [/p][p]1. Fixed some NPC lookup/search issues that occurred when the number of buildings increased, such as taking too long to find a bed.[/p]

notes.title: Update & Optimizations:
notes.notes: [p]Update & Optimizations: [/p][p]1. Fixed an issue where loading a save during a beast horde would cause the horde to respawn. [/p][p]2. Fixed an exploit that allowed item duplication by renaming items in chests.[/p]

notes.title: Update & Optimizations:
notes.notes: [p]Update & Optimizations: [/p][p]1. Increased collision spacing between creatures to minimize overlapping. [/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where sleeping for a long time would cause items generated from rot to duplicate. [/p][p]3. Fixed an issue where quick-using items from the inventory did not reset spoilage. [/p][p]4. Fixed a temporary display bug where food slots showed full durability after clicking. [/p][p]5. Removed save overwrite on death. [/p][p]6. Expanded manual save slots from 1 to 5. [/p]

notes.title: Game Release Delay Notice～
notes.notes:
[code]Game Release Delay Notice～
    This delay is unexpected and not our choice. The game itself is complete. We received an email from Steam stating that "Island Notes" requires an additional review. The official email did not specify the reason, only estimating it will take an extra three to five business days. I want to sincerely apologize to all the eagerly waiting players. For now, we must wait for Steam to complete this additional review. Once it's done, I will notify each of you personally. I'll also use these next few days to continue polishing the game, ensuring we deliver the absolute best experience to you all～[/code]

notes.title: Update Fixes:
notes.notes:
Update Fixes:
1. Replaced the graphics API, now choosing a more stable graphics API that significantly reduces crashes, rendering errors, and inability to enter the game.
2. The new graphics API brings substantial performance improvements, increasing frame rates by 40%-70%.
3. Added range restrictions to elite bears.
4. Added distance control to the fish basket UI.
5. Added automatic stand-up for downed NPCs, with relatively slow stand-up speed.
6. Prevented companion creatures waiting in position from being knocked away.

notes.title: Update Fixes:
notes.notes:
Update Fixes:
1. Significantly optimized creature performance issues, especially in scenarios with excessive creatures and group battles.
2. Fixed the issue where NPCs would hide inside rocks.
3. Improved the problem of whales sliding ashore along terrain.

notes.title: Update Fixes:
notes.notes:
Update Fixes:
1. Optimized NPC behavior logic and further corrected some incorrect NPC behaviors.
2. Further optimized performance when there are many companions.
3. Significantly increased the chance of redprints producing red items.
4. Added mutated bears, including mutated bear hatching (elite bears can also drop them).
5. Improved the issue where creature companions often overlapped—now larger creatures will push away smaller ones.
6. Added knockback between creatures (larger ones push back smaller ones).
7. Rebalanced the creature growth system.
8. Changed the fishing trap's fish acquisition method—previously fixed, now it's a real fishing trap that must be placed in fish-concentrated areas to catch fish.
9. Added a marker UI for fishing traps.
10. Farmland can now be enhanced with earthworms to increase planting success rate, and farmland quality now also affects planting success.
11. Significantly increased armor defense.
12. Greatly expanded the damage range of the lightning chain device, now three times larger.
13. Fixed a bug caused by frequently returning to the main menu.
14. Now, you can quickly convert tender grass using a campfire.

notes.title: [Major Update] New Version Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your attention and support! The new version of the Demo has been updated. This update includes a significant number of changes, so if you have any questions or discover any bugs, feel free to mention them in the group or game community—I’ll address and fix them as soon as possible.  

**Important Note:**  
The new version is compatible with **official release save files**, meaning old Demo saves will no longer work. Below are the detailed updates:  

### **Update Details**  
0. Added a swimsuit outfit for companions.  
1. Added a **custom NPC body shape and face-editing system** to the Demo.  
2. Added an **armor system**, including linen-crafted armor sets.  
3. Added a **dynamic weather system**, along with deep interactions between characters and weather.  
4. Introduced a **temperature system**—core body temperature is affected by clothing thickness, ambient temperature, proximity to heat sources, being underwater, huddling, food intake, and more.  
5. Added a **Beast Tide system**—monsters will track players and attack bases (can be disabled in difficulty settings).  
6. Added **lightning gameplay**—players can use lightning rods and conduction devices to harness thunderbolts in combat. (Warning: Lightning may also strike players or structures, dealing massive damage unless redirected by a lightning rod.)  
7. Added **status effects (Buffs/Debuffs)**: Poison, Bleeding, Fire, Ice, Shock, and "Abnormal" (unique to the Island Log). Weapons may randomly gain these effects during crafting, or drop with higher mutation rates when killing affected enemies.  
8. Improved **NPC AI**—she can now craft items, assess player status, give items, assist in weapon forging, and more.  
9. NPCs can **gain or lose weight** (toggleable in difficulty settings).  
10. Added a **map system** with custom markers and waypoints.  
11. Introduced **multiple save slots**.  
12. Added **tree-falling animations** and other visual effects.  
13. Added a **"Transfer Only Existing Items"** button for containers.  
14. **Creature formations** now remain intact after combat unless obstructed.  
15. Added **"Destroy" and "Disable Attack"** buttons for creatures.  
16. Expanded **difficulty settings** for a more challenging survival experience.  
17. **Visual optimizations**.  
18. New items: Poison Arrows, Lightning Rods, Braziers, and Linen Armor Sets.  
19. Revised **NPC affinity system**—some actions now require minimum affinity levels (current cap: 80).  
20. Miscellaneous bug fixes.  

Once again, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update Fixes:
notes.notes:
Update Fixes:
1. Added an Elite Hercules Beetle (note: while weaker than Elite Bear, it remains a BOSS-tier enemy). Defeating it grants improved Hercules Beetle Eggs and Cultivation Blueprints. Advanced cultivation plots now double harvest yields to boost herb-growing efficiency.
2. Swapped spawn locations of Elite Hercules Beetle and Elite Bear (Elite Bear now spawns in the open area near Bamboo Cliff – players with bases here must relocate to allow spawns).
3. Significantly increased loot bag and corpse despawn timers.
4. Adjusted daylight illumination settings.
5. Fixed a bug where pressing ESC during dialogue selection caused mouse cursor disappearance.
6. Added movement boundaries for BOSSes – they now reset to spawn points if exceeding range.
7. Added movement restriction warnings during story segments.
8. Temporarily disabled companion targeting of eagles (to prevent erratic pathfinding). Expanded companion controls planned for future updates.
9. Optimized resource respawn mechanics.
10. Extended spear disappearance delay.

notes.title: Performance Update:
notes.notes:
Performance Update:
Optimized CPU peak usage and enhanced system compatibility, reducing resource consumption during multi-threaded tasks and improving support for legacy Windows versions.

notes.title: Update Optimization:
notes.notes:
Update Optimization:
We've optimized CPU performance and adjusted data structures for enhanced efficiency.

Important Notice:
Recently, some players have reported issues such as unresponsive movement, malfunctioning keys, or inability to collect items, rendering the game unplayable. Our investigation indicates that these issues may be caused by Windows Defender or other antivirus software. To address this, we've made structural adjustments to our data systems. If you encounter similar problems, please add the game to your antivirus software's allowlist (whitelist) or temporarily disable your antivirus before launching the game.
